question: Which of the following processes occurs before fertilisation in sexually reproducing plants?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pollination**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Pollination** is the biological process of transferring **pollen grains** from the **anther** (the male reproductive part) to the **stigma** (the female reproductive part) of a flower.
 
• In the life cycle of **sexually reproducing plants**, pollination is categorized as a **pre-fertilization** event. It is the essential prerequisite that brings the **male gametes** in proximity to the **female gamete** located within the **ovule**. ***Hence, statement 4 is correct.***
 
• Once pollination is successful, the **pollen grain** germinates on the stigma, producing a **pollen tube** that travels down the **style** to reach the **ovary** for the fusion of gametes.
